html:
Discover the stunning beauty of Nha Trang Bay with Vietlook Travel on an exciting 3-island tour. This journey combines crystal-clear waters, colorful coral areas, local island life, and relaxing beach time. It is a perfect experience for travelers who want to swim, explore the sea, and enjoy unforgettable moments in Nha Trang.

TOUR ITINERARY

08:00 – 08:30
Car and professional English-speaking tour guide pick you up at the meeting point.

08:45
Board a speed canoe and start the island-hopping adventure.

SAN HO BAY

09:00
Arrive at San Ho Bay. Free time to swim, relax, and enjoy the sea. Complimentary beach chairs are provided.
Guests may join optional water activities at their own expense, such as jet ski, parasailing, scuba diving, sea walking, banana boat, and more.

FISHING VILLAGE

11:00
Visit a traditional fishing village.

Have lunch at a local restaurant on the island, where fresh seafood and local specialties are available (own expense).

After lunch, relax and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of island life.

BAI TRANH BEACH

12:30
Transfer by canoe to Bai Tranh Beach.

Free time to swim and relax at two natural beaches on the island (Cat Beach and Soi Beach).

Complimentary use of beach chairs and huts.

Optional water sports outside the program are available at own expense, such as parasailing, jet ski, banana boat, etc.

14:00
Return to the mainland by canoe. End of the tour.

TOUR PRICE

Price per person (pax): USD 18

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Pick-up and drop-off by car

  • Speed canoe transportation

  • Lunch on the island

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Entrance fees

  • Bottled water

  • Beach chairs and resting huts

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • VAT

  • Personal expenses

  • Optional water activities outside the program

CHILDREN POLICY

  • Children under 1 meter: Free of charge

  • From 1m to 1.29m: 70% of adult price

  • From 1.29m and above: Adult price applies
outline: Day 1: DISCOVER NHA TRANG BEACH 3 ISLAND TOUR
